snippet.title: End of Ember | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

End of Ember is a love letter to classic horror films, where over-the-top gore was funnier than reruns of Family Ties. Join Ember as she is accidentally sent to Hell on her birthday and wades through a gory underworld to find the truth about her origins. This brand new gameplay trailer shows off the game’s gross and gruesome action along with a hint at its cutscenes and story. Did we mention gore?

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3217880/End_of_Ember/
